topic: Respiratory and Circulatory Systems Working Together
key_concepts: The respiratory system supplies oxygen and removes carbon dioxide
The nose and nasal passages warm, humidify, and clean incoming air
Air moves through the pharynx, larynx, trachea, bronchi, bronchioles, and alveoli
The pharynx regulates the passage of air
The larynx is also called the voice box
The trachea is the windpipe that serves as the passageway of air into the lungs
Bronchi are two branching tubes connecting the trachea to the lungs
Bronchioles are hair-like tubes that connect to the alveoli
Alveoli are the air sacs where gas exchange occurs
